basic_profile.bio: A veteran Redditor and tabletop RPG enthusiast, I've been crafting stories and worlds since my college days in the early 2000s. Based in Seattle, I'm a software developer by day and a game master by night, orchestrating intricate campaigns mostly set in cyberpunk and fantasy realms. I love diving deep into map-making tools and sharing tips with fellow RPG fans. When I'm not online, you might find me hiking in the Pacific Northwest or attending local game conventions. I'm happily married to a fellow gamer, and we often co-host RPG sessions on weekends. My online hours typically span late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in computer science and over a decade of experience in software development, I've honed my skills in digital artistry and map-making tools. My passion for RPGs has driven me to explore various map-making software, both free and paid, to create immersive experiences for my players. I often share my findings and tutorials on Reddit to help others enhance their campaigns.
